content: Standard practice for image transfer over LoRa (stuartsprojects Large Data Transfers with LoRa; MDPI Sensors 2024 iPacket=(seqNo,imgData)): split image into payload-size chunks (51-255B), per-chunk sequence number + CRC, ARQ with retransmission on CRC-fail/timeout using stop-and-wait or sliding window, receiver reassembles by sequence number. Matches D-21 windowed request/response design already locked in CONTEXT.md.
